description: Error::FromHttpStatus produces identical output for network failures, SAP application errors, and protocol bugs. Lock errors already have hints; activation/source-write/object-create do not. Fix: pattern-match known SAP error strings (session expired, lock conflict, missing transport, connection reset) to attach a one-line hint pointing at what to do. Example: when 400 body contains 'Session not found' → hint 'ADT session may be expired. Retry or use --session-file to persist.' Affects: src/adt/activation.cpp, src/adt/source.cpp, src/adt/object.cpp, src/adt/transport.cpp. Codex review severity: major.
title: Improve error messages: add actionable hints for common ADT failure modes

description: Nothing in Result<T,E> (core/result.hpp) prevents accidentally copying a Result wrapping a move-only type. This will silently fail to compile in a confusing way, or worse, compile and double-free if copy semantics are wrong. Fix: add static_assert(std::is_copy_constructible_v<T> && std::is_copy_constructible_v<E>) when copy ctor is used, or conditionally delete copy ctor/assignment when T/E is not copyable. Codex review severity: major.
title: Add static_assert to Result<T,E> to enforce copy/move semantics when T is move-only

description: In source.cpp and lock_workflow.cpp, if a write fails midway the LockGuard destructor releases the lock — correct under normal conditions. However if the process is killed (SIGKILL, OOM) the SAP lock handle leaks server-side and objects remain locked. Fix is not a code change: document this limitation at the top of lock_workflow.cpp and WriteSourceWithAutoLock, note that SAP systems auto-expire locks after a timeout (default ~10 min), and consider logging a warning if the unlock in the destructor fails so operators know to manually unlock via erpl-adt object unlock. Codex review severity: major.
title: Document lock-leak risk on process kill during write workflow

description: Every ADT module (activation.cpp, object.cpp, checks.cpp, search.cpp, ddic.cpp, etc.) repeats the same tinyxml2 boilerplate: XMLDocument doc; doc.Parse(); root = RootElement(); null-check; error return. Extract a template helper ParseXmlWithRoot<T>(xml, operation, endpoint, error_msg, fn) that handles parse+null-check and calls fn(root) returning Result<T,Error>. Place in src/adt/xml_utils.hpp (already exists per CLAUDE.md). Codex review severity: minor.
title: Extract shared ParseXmlWithRoot helper to eliminate XML boilerplate duplication

description: LockGuard destructor can run on a guard that was never successfully acquired, risking a double-unlock or null dereference on session_. Fix: add explicit acquired_ = false member, set to true only after Acquire() returns success. Destructor must gate on acquired_ && !released_ && session_ before calling UnlockObject. File: src/adt/locking.cpp. Codex review severity: critical.
title: Fix LockGuard RAII: add acquired_ flag to prevent destructor on unacquired guard

close_reason: Fixed: ParseActivationResultXml now detects SAP Cloud format (chkl:messages as root), parses chkl:properties activationExecuted attribute, and sets ActivationResult::activation_executed. ReportActivationOutcome distinguishes clean activation from nothing-to-activate. 3 new regression tests added.
description: ParseActivationResultXml in activation.cpp counts messages from chkl:messages to determine total/activated/failed. When SAP returns 200 with no msg elements but ioc:inactiveObjects entries still present, the function returns total=0 and the CLI reports 'Nothing to activate' — a false success. This was the direct cause of the class write+activate bug in this session where inactive version existed but activation was silently dropped. Fix: after parsing messages, check ioc:inactiveObjects for remaining ioc:entry elements and increment failed+total for each. File: src/adt/activation.cpp ParseActivationResultXml(). Codex review severity: major.
title: Fix activation result parsing: ioc:inactiveObjects entries must count as failure even with no msg elements
